definitions.success_rate: Successful trials divided by every planned case/repeat, including missing and blocked trials.
definitions.stage_funnel: Independent observed check statuses; later hidden checks do not feed back into the worker.
definitions.elapsed_seconds: Worker pipeline wall duration, including cleanup; independent hidden checks are timed separately.
definitions.iterations_per_stage: Persisted actual stage iteration rows, including stage re-entry.
definitions.llm_calls_per_stage: Actual provider attempt reservations, including provider retries; summary calls count in their stage.
definitions.cost: USD is null when unavailable. Known-subset spend is not total benchmark spend.
definitions.reported_success_hidden_correctness: Build-tier app DONE is the denominator; a pass requires hidden tests bound to the selected delivered source hash. T4 scope decisions are excluded.
definitions.crash: Unexpected exception explicitly recorded by Worker as Worker failed(Type), or escaping Worker.execute. Provider/RTL failures are not automatically crashes.
definitions.hang: Independent configured pipeline wall deadline fired; cleanup is awaited before another trial starts.
definitions.terminal_message_proxy: Presence of a stripped terminal Run.error or Run.summary. Presence does not establish a clear or useful explanation.
definitions.explanation_clarity: Explicit manual review only; unreviewed explanations cannot satisfy a semantic-clarity target.
